reviews.review:
I liked it very much.
Will follow this fellow developer, I think they have a bright future.

Incredible story and can't wait to see where this leads to. It's very much a graphic novel - made - interactive game, with puzzles to keep you engaged. Highly recommended to anyone who enjoys puzzles and a strong story.

Probably my mistake for expecting something akin to Hacknet from this game: it's FAR from that. 
The story is predictable and honestly feels like someone's first read of MKUltra on Wikipedia, interactivity with the computer & clues is [b]very[/b] limited (most introduced systems only get used literally once throughout the whole game) and it's just a very short game, which isn't fitting for its price tag. 
Other reviews mentioned that this game feels polished, but what's the point when it's so basic?.. Felt like I just wasted my time at the end of it, especially due to that sorry excuse of an ending.

Not really a game, more like a short visual novel.  

The puzzles are simple, you press a view buttons and they are very hard to mess up at all.  The writing is okay, every character feels like a plot device rather than an actual person, and they only speak to you in the tone of that plot device.

Interesting idea but definitely needs more fleshing out for this price, if you thought this game was "be a detective that helps solve cases while there is a mysterious plot slowing unfolding in the background" you are mistaken.  This is a game that instantly throws you into the conspiracy plot and gives you no wiggle room to escape from it.

Took about 7 hours for me to get through it... but worth every penny.  I loved every minute of it.  It's a game where paying attention to everything does help.  It's a great puzzle game with a great story... Now they need to make a follow dlc or I'm rioting...

剧情紧凑，环环紧扣，整条故事的逻辑线和最后的结局是意料之外情理之中。加上特别的互动玩法，整个游戏的真实性和代入感极强。第一次打完之后还有其他谜题没有破解，可以多次游玩。

The narrative is tightly woven, with every event intricately connected, creating a cohesive and compelling storyline. The logical progression of the plot culminates in a conclusion that, while unexpected, feels entirely fitting and satisfying. The unique interactive gameplay enhances the sense of realism and immersion, making the experience deeply engaging.

One of the standout features is the replayability factor. After completing the game for the first time, several puzzles remain unsolved, inviting players to dive back in for multiple playthroughs. This ensures that each session feels fresh and offers new challenges, maintaining the game's intrigue and excitement.
one of the best games ive played in a while, took me 3 hours, great for streamers looking for a puzzle game
"Incredible" is the word !
Short but sweet. Worth the full price imo.
I really love this type of game, and this was so much fun to play! Definitely recommended. A really good level of difficulty, and a good mix of types of tasks.

A little bit on the short side 4~5h, but what a fantastic story. The voices, the little puzzles, the ambiance !
I'm sad it's already finished and sad I can't play it again for the first time.
Would love to have a longer sequel if the quality is at this level, maybe less linear.

I think it's worth it even with the linear story, and even with the 4 to 5 hour length.

EXCELLENT!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Very very short but interesting and well made!

A few more "cases" to investigate with the cool tools you have at your disposal would have been  greatly appreciated...

Amazing experience, I was completely captivated during the whole game. 
Thank you so much for this experience !! <3 <3

It's by far the shortest game i have ever played. I went to it slowly and didn't surpass the 4 hours mark. That's unacceptable, especially because the mechanics were there and it just lacked more content.  It felt like an introduction but then it suddenly ends. The story is meh, pretty obvious and with a little more inspired writing it could be less predictable. I really wanted to like the game because it had nice ideas like the *nix inspired console and other interesting things. The people finder was used a couple of times, the chemical analysis only one time, this can't be meant seriously.
It was a fun game up until the abrupt and very unsatisfying ending. This is a very short game that ends on what should be the completion of the first act.
reviews.developer_response: I'm sorry you disliked the ending, but happy you had fun up until then. Our goal for the next project is to expand on this universe and create a bigger, more ambitious game with more puzzles and complexity. We felt like we couldn't really do that with this project because of budgetary and time constraints. Again, thanks for playing our game.

reviews.review: i def recommend this game, its super good. it was well made and very interesting BUT i do think it should have been longer. it ends the story with a lot of questions unanswered and i dislike that aspect of it.
short and fun

Even with its 3-4 Hour length of gameplay, I loved the game style, and the side-quests (depending on if you trust people), that you get to do within the game.

I feel like there could be additions added onto this game, but also replayibility, so you can continue at certain points in the chapter, to see how you could of played your career out differently.

I would much recommend this game!

I wish I could erase my memory of this game just to experience it all over again. It's an incredible journey. If you're after a short, VERY high-quality story game with brilliantly crafted puzzles, this is the one for you~
the game is simple, but with a special atmosphere - u r doing some basic task to get fast into the sad story without knowing...
Incredibly good game, shame the story is short as I would have loved to keep playing for hours. Still very good story and can't wait to see more.

buy it 
look at literally nothing about the game
just buy it
10/10

Maybe my expectations weren't set properly but I was going into this game hoping to fill the shoes of an FBI operator : 

- Analyse photos, videos, samples
- Search and match data accross differents sources
- Analyse piles of documents or suspects conversations
- etc.

in order to make some deductions and help ongoing investigations. 

This is what you get for the first 25% of the game. 
After that, it slowly shifts into a narrative driven experience, where your choices don't matter (the game is programmed to end one way), the scenario is at best foreseeable at worst blatantly cliché. All the investigation mechanics that you were taught are thrown out the window and never used again. 

The scenario felt like drinking room-temperature water. It's uninteresting, not particulary pleasant and completely forgettable. Overall it feels like a huge bait and switch
Good game, very nice atmosphere, good good overall for any detective gamers :)

Fantastic detective/investigation game where you play as a phone operator for the FDI (definitely not the FBI). As you help agents in the field, you start uncovering some things you shouldn't...

It's short and sweet but the story is intense and full of great reveals. The presentation is fantastic and the puzzles are tricky but not so hard you get bogged down. Everything is well paced and executed. The voice acting and script are great.

Without spoiling, an end-credit scene hints at more coming. I really hope we get more.
Great game, interesting story. But it ends far to quickly and abruptly. At the end I felt unsatisfied and craving for more.

This was absurdly good for its price, kept me on my toes from beginning to end. Fun puzzles, creative ways to interact with the limited tools you have.
The dialogue is really good, the VAs are awesome and the soundtrack is nuts.
The game is pretty short but that's to its benefit imo, as the pacing is well planned.
>Have fun :)

Amazing story and gameplay... at the end it feels like you are sooo into the story.
It gave me goosebumps at the end... recommend it 100%
Really fun Story
Very good, can't wait for the next part

Not bad at all. Good mystery/intrigue story without having to dip into supernatural stuff.

Short, so it's more like a two-part episode of X Files or something like that than a full season, but hopefully the high quality of the game means they can attract investment money to put together longer games. I certainly wouldn't mind a longer game using the same mechanics.
You can disable a bomb in this game 10/10
You might want to wait for a sale, it's very short. Way shorter than I thought it was going to be, even if you get someone killed.

An amazing game with so many unexpected plot-twists that actually make sense! Alot of games tend to have plot twists for the sake of "keeping things interesting", but everything came around full circle and actually had me on the edge of my seat!

The ONLY negative thing I can say about The Operator is that it was WAY too short for the amount of shock and surprise it caused me hahaha, I wish they could extend the game.

Aside from that, easy 10/10, one of the best story games I have ever played.

I thoroughly enjoyed the game "The Operator." It reminded me of the game series "Orwell" and "Papers, Please." Despite its short length, it's well worth the money. I'll definitely purchase the second part or any DLC from that developer.
three letters: W T F?????
Great little game! I feel like it was a bit too short (finished in a little over 3 hours), but I would definitely play any future episodes if they're released.
Very short. Not as mysterious as they would like it to be.Dissapointing. Gameplay is fun, but its over in a flash. Should probably not cost as much, seeing as you finish it in a couple of hours.

So all in all, this game is great!
I found the story very captivating, as I completed the game in one sitting.
But I do have to agree with the other reviews.

Though the story is great, there is only one perspective, instantly removing all the replay value minus achievements.
It did feel good having some of my original assumptions actually being correct, and the joy in making the correct connections really improved my look towards this game.

So here's my breakdown:

Pros:
- Captivating Story
- Great use of the atmosphere, all the sounds around really helped me get "into the game"
- Relatively new concept. (At least in what I've seen)

Now the Cons..
- Way too short and no replay value
- I think some of the puzzles could be a bit more difficult as I did breeze through most of them


For my overall rating of 7/10, I really did enjoy this experience; I hope the story is continued either in this game through updates or in a separate title.

The Operator is a great narrative game which brings back all the feelings of the X-Files and Millenium as you play as a Federal agent or operator helping Agents in the field examine evidence and uncover a mystery (I dont want to say too much but the intro really puts you in mind of the X-Files from the get go!) 

A lovely, entertaining, puzzling and at times blood racing game! Totally worth it and I loved it! 

The [spoiler] Bomb defusing [/spoiler] section was particularly awesome! Love it!

I received a key for the game although I already had it in my wishlist and was intending to buy it.

ORWELL: Keeping an Eye on You this is not, but it is a satisfying game for the time it sticks around. My primary complaint, as is shared by many others, is that I want more. The entire game can be completed in just over two hours and many of the tools you are provided with you will only use once. The entire game feels like a chapter one, and I was invested enough in it to hope that there would be more. I'll leave this one on the backburner for now, but if more comes, I'll be there for it.
For a 3-4 hour experience, it was quite the roller coaster.
i wish that the game last longer. I love it. Graphics they are all so realistic and the story caught you in.
This is a great game with a good storyline, lots of twists and turns!
A fun experience that I wish was a bit longer. There's definitely a lot that's left on the table for this game and I hope to see more in the future, but whats here is still real good
Amazing plot! Worth every penny.
This game was amazing, the puzzles, and graphics were amazing. It has such a great story!! Highly recomend.
Great game

Awesome investigative story. Sometimes the solutions to puzzles are simpler than expected, but most are thought provoking. Relatively short (2-4 hours) for a full playthrough, but worth the price because of the story, audio, and voice acting.
its like im a field operator so immerse and great story

WHAT A NICE LITTLE GAME! I do wish that it was a little longer - unless I played the game wrong, or if things are different on another play through - but I wish you had more chances to use the tools that you get. It's not a long game so I don't want to spoil anything.

Regardless, I definitely had fun! It's a very nice story-focused puzzle game! :)

I would recommend getting this on sale.

The core gameplay is pretty strong. Puzzles are for me in the sweet spot of just hard enough to be engaging without being impossible. There are some sequences that are incredibly tense and well done.

The story is predictable but presented well enough. By the end of the game I had some attachment to the characters. I did predict most of the "twists" basically immediately but the journey was entertaining enough. Some of the writing was a bit corny but never enough to fully break immersion. Also, you do play as a white guy so I have to dock some points for that.

Your choices don't have a real effect on the wider narrative, either, which is disappointing. If you were to buy this, think of it more as an interactive movie than a choose your own adventure game.

It took me around 2.5 hours to finish the game. There is no replay value. If the devs release another game in this series in the same format I will consider buying it.

6.5/10 overall. Enjoyable experience but not particularly memorable. Well designed core mechanics/conceit but predictable and mid story. Looking forward to next game from developer.
I might be a little biased because i love stories like this that are mind-bending MK ULTRA shit

Great game. Great potential. story line was very nice and well made. you will finish under 3 hours tho. It is one main story line, Do not expect multiple random cases like the game CSI (if in futur it become that i would be amazing) still a great game. i recommand
This game was very satisfying and super well thought out. I enjoyed the story so much I just wish it had been longer :(

Great game, I am baffled at the quality of the game from this new indie studio. Without reavealing anything, its wonderfully made and created to meet the needs of a investigative game. Its a way to view being an operator behind a desk in a federal department but it holds more in store than other investigative game these days. I played the demo and was honestly suprised but the full game surpasses my expectations! Make sure to support  the developpers and to buy the game.
Absolute CINEMA! From the gameplay, to the storyline. Don't look up anything about this game, if the trailer seems to be interesting... just get it, you won't regret it!
Incredible story, much effort put into the game and a perfect game to finish in one day. Gripping story pulls you in the entire time,

Game is great! Very in depth good voice acting and dialog, has room for plenty of updates! hopefully most are free.

Really recommend this game for anyone that likes those hacker simulator type of games!

An interesting idea that has trouble finding pace, the story seems like it's told in 10x speed and holds your hand pretty hard. Would recommend if it was on sale, but not at full price for how short it is unfortunately.
This game is amazing. If you enjoy mystery and solving puzzles, this game is for you.
Short little game, similar to other hacking esque games but with variety of minigames. Very story focused though

Quite disappointed with the game, barely 3 hours and no complexity in the storyline or gameplay. 
The first part of the game is very good (the demo and a bit more), one expects a 'Papers, Please' style with routine investigations hiding a deeper secret. But in the end, you get 4-5 pseudo-investigations and then a very linear sequence of scenes with very little research and an ultra-simple plot... 
The few original interactions are nice but used only once... 
Adding more investigations without impacting the main storyline by reusing the tools would have really added a lot to the game...
Not worth it or I had too many expectations (and a slightly exaggerated game description on the store page)
Short fun puzzle game with cool story
amazing game
fun little puzzler and reading game, just enough narrative choice to make you feel special but maybe a little overpriced for the duration of the game

Fun puzzle game!  Worth the 13$ I picked it up for. 

I did 100% in only 4.7 hours. The Operator is a story game with puzzles that is a linear experience.

I think it had a lot of cool aspects that I wish Bureau 81 leaned into.For example the terminal is only used for like 1 puzzle. 

The art direction of the game is really  cool as well. It is rendered in Unity but with the effects on the "videos" it looks like CCTV which is nice touch for a detective game.

Overall it was a fun experience and if you were a fan of Her Story, Unheard, or those FMV detective games you will enjoy this one.  8/10

This game is short. I beat it in 3 hours. Dont let this prevent you from buying. The story is amazing, and while I predicted the major twist on either day 1 or 2 (cant remember), it is a exilerating ride. It also plants the seeds for more, and I really do hope that those seeds flourish.

You will especially enjoy this game if you enjoyed Cyber Manhunt 1 or 2, or any of the Orwell games. 

My only critisms is that some mechanics are only used once, for example the substance material tracing stuff is only used once, and it could have been fun to use it a little more. I also feel like there is more to this game, but reasearch online suggests that there is only one ending. Heres hoping a sequel quells this for me.
Game is really fun!

Love this game so far! Big into investigating games and this genre.

Def has been worth the wait
Love it, it's short but good, would love a sequel.

I teetered on the border of a positve and negative review.  I will echo that the game itself is phenomenal when it comes to immersion.  The puzzles are just the right amount of difficult (admittedly I had to use the hint button more than once).  But I was disappointed when 1.  The game lasted me just over 3.5 hours, and 2.  The story is linear.  A game like this has so much potential there for multiple endings, choices affecting the game, etc, and I expected more.  IDK.. I feel like playing the demo version pretty much delivered everything the full game did,.  I ended leaving unsatisfied, like I was just so close to itching that spot but fell short.  I hope that the developers continue making games with players' feedback in mind- there is great potential.

I got this game with the launch offer. Usually this is not the kind of game that I play but nevertheless I really liked it, and I would surely recommend it to people who like this kind of puzzle/investigation games. What I see is a great potential for future development, with updates or even a DLC. The ending is a bit disappointing because in a game with these many choices just a single ending no matter what you do really impedes replayability. I finished it twice with different choices just to see if something changes but it did not. There are very sophisticated features that are used just once and again they could have done more. The story is nice and immersive but a bit on the short side.

i just finish the game and i swear i needed a game like that with a really good story and new ideas its a make you think twice before making a move and the game has moved my feeling soooooo hard 

dont think twice buy this game

Game has good base features, such as databases and interactable video/image search functions, as well as references to certain lab and analysis tools. There was also good voice acting and character designs.
However, I had not realized game was such a railroaded linear story line with no real choices or variation in gameplay. Several points where game takes control from player and forces unnecessary video or audio cutscenes that do not add well to the experience or even the story. Certain events forcibly squish the interactable area of the screen, making it difficult to maneuver through the various game elements needed to continue. Not friendly to slow readers, as whenever a new line of text appears, it forces the log to the bottom, forcing you to wait until the whole conversation is over to double check the one thing you wanted to check in the conversation, such as spelling of a name you want to look up.
Would not recommend for anything more than $4.99

I loved the game, it got me hooked so damn hard i even checked the whole credits because i was on the edge of my seat and they got me hooked into the characters. 
but yes i finished it in 2.1 hours so i think its very short i hope something else like this will be released more mission type because the detective thing was a great game by itself but with a whole story in between its just the best.

ABSOLUTELY 10/10.

First time playing a game, like this where it's investigative but has a hidden meaning/deeper meaning.
Kept me on the edge of my seat for mostly all of the game,
Would recommend this game to anyone if you are looking for a story...
Best story I have actually had in a while and would love for more gametime.

The developers who worked on the sound and music definitely deserve praise. The game does a great job in creating tension and the game play is satisfying enough where it doesn't feel like a chore. The game play and mystery solving aspect of it is engaging and somewhat challenging. 

However, this is where I wish Steam had a "Sort of Recommend" option. The game as a package was good enough to get the thumbs up from me, however the story is very short and leaves a lot to be desired. The choices don't mean anything, and the ending feels extremely rushed. This game would have benefited with a bit more fleshing out of the story. It's a shame because the environment, tension and characters are very interesting and it would have been nice to spend a bit more time in the world.

Overall, if you enjoy mystery games with point-and-click gameplay, you'll have an enjoyable time.

A good little game, although the lack of multiple endings makes replaying it limited. Overall I recommend it, some of the twists are great but it felt a little rushed in places. It could probably do with giving you a little more time and a few more missions that are less high stakes to crack some puzzles and use some of the tools a little more, a lot of the tools you end up using only once.

*
So the ending is a little bit...sad. It opens it up for a sequel but also everyone you worked with gets screwed over. I thought I had the bad ending and had somehow messed up.

Reading the review, a common complaint I see is directed at the length of the experience. Don't let that dissuade you, it's a gripping, one-of-a-kind experience that had me glued throughout the whole experience!
The presentation is superb, with great voice acting, tense music and fantastic art direction. The story is tight, and admittedly, it left me wanting more. But I see that as an indication of how incredibly much I enjoyed the experience!
It almost feels like an Annapurna-release in how tight and refreshing it all felt and played.
Obvious "thumbs up" from me.
This game is amazing!!!!  It just needed to be longer or more games created!

My first review on Steam...because this game is that good!

Yes, it is a little short as my playtime was just shy of 4 hours. But at the £10-£12 mark, it's definitely worth it. The game is mostly linear/heavily story-based, but it's an incredibly engrossing tale. Likewise, the gameplay really makes you feel like you're performing an investigation. While it's not too hard, it's challenging enough to keep you engaged. (And if you get stuck, there's a pretty subtle hint system.) Also, huge round of applause for the writing and the voice acting. It's top notch, considering this is an indie game.

Overall, this is a strong recommend. I have my fingers crossed for a direct story sequel (and hopefully a longer playtime too.)  But I also wouldn't mind seeing this style of gameplay being used in other situations. For example, an emergency services operator dealing with a serial arsonist, or a private security company operator dealing with a series of break-ins. The possibilities are endless!

I have never made a review but this game is so ridiculously short. Like other reviewers have said, basically this is a fun game. great design, great depth, great detail, everything. just the fact that it's 3 hours...? is absurd. This is a demo at best. 

I do not recommend this game unless you enjoy being teased. Despite the low price, save your $.
Amazing, fun and brilliant story. Teaser at the end made me excited for a second game :)

Absolutely amazing games, keeps you guessing right until the end. 

Short but very sweet, worth every penny.

Would like more endings for the game instead of just one.

A chapter selector for when you finish the game could be nice for simple achievement hunting instead of having to replay it all.

Was a bit too easy at the beginning and the story was foreseeable, or so I thought. Liked the twist and ending of the game after playing it but would have loved different endings/ meaning for decisions taken. Still, thanks for the experience, Devs.
This was one of my favorite games from the year so far the twists and turns were so unexpected. The ending really through me for a loop. 10/10 would play again and would recommend.

Thrilling investigation with nice mechanics. While the some parts of the story were predictable the game was still fun. Would recommend if you are looking for a game that has some investigation and an intriguing environment.

Extremely good, the content in it is of high quality, it is well acted and well written-even if archetypal, the different techniques are entertaining. I liked the artistic choices of the non-played parts -just everything in it is done well, and it is small team (I watched the credits. lol) 
It is a shame it is so short, the days are short and there are only four. It felt like you never really got to settle in, learn the techniques, spend any real significant time with characters before the main events, you are told you are friends with people without actually experiencing any friendship, which effects later emotional beats. 
Reminiscent of CaseCracker (1+2) but with much higher budget/quality but much much shorter.

The game is good, and it's fun to play, but I don't think the story is enough to justify buying it full price. The ending being a cliffhanger sucks, as I was expecting some sort of conclusion to any part of the story and got none. We learned one crucial piece of information about ourselves and then the story ends. I hope any additional chapters/episodes of the story are free because this story is incomplete.

Not my usual type of game. I'm more into shooting monsters in the face. But I loved it. Yeah it's short, but given the price point, I have no complaints at all. A very well put together game and I'm looking forward to a sequel or DLC(?)
Short but sweet, can't wait for part 2.
This game, if you could even call it that, was such a good experience, in both the plot and the gameplay, that i would spend my last cent to buy this.
this game is more than you expect, more secrets that you find while playing and actually well written, deff recommend anyone to play this game, it's worth your time.....

Simple but oh so effective. The less you know about it the better just be sure to give it a go and enjoy one of the most inventive games released this year. 
Closest comparison I have is the narrative adventure game Stories Untold.

If you're looking for an Indie title that feels immersive, this is your game. I loved the conversations and how natural they felt. All in all, a solid game that's not like the others with a wonderful storyline to keep you interested. 

P.s. Watch the credits to the end :)

NO SPOILERS 
wow
Some good plot (a few parts were obvious), and i like the ending. Without doing any spoilers, you want to know more, you want the game to continue

Well done Bureau 81, and i hope this game will have enough success to give you the opportunity to make a longer one
I wish you could replay it with all the knowledge, but its a very good game nevertheless
